feeds.title: The Basket Room
feeds.description: The Basket Room creates beautiful collections of handwoven, decorative storage baskets for the home. Woven with stunning colours & unique patterns, we work with small craft collectives in Africa to bring you ethical, stylish, accessories with a story.

feeds.title: Matt Tommey Blog
feeds.description: Matt Tommey makes North Carolina baskets for modern rustic decor out of natural materials straight from the mountains of Asheville.

feeds.title: Contemporary Basketry
feeds.description: Carol eckert is a contemporary basket maker at caroleckert.com. Follow this blog to know more about concepts, forms, materials, techniques, and processes related to basketry.

feeds.title: Southwestern Ontario Basketry Guild
feeds.description: Founded in April 2003, the guild has flourished and become a dedicated group of basketmakers from a wide area. They are committed to spreading the art of basketry through educational programs, workshops and study groups.

feeds.title: Katie Grove Studios Blog
feeds.description: As an artist my passion is create art with all natural materials that I harvest and prepare from the beautiful landscape around my home. As an educator I guide adults and children alike in connecting to their creative self through the combination of art and nature. I have a background in Fibers Art from Tyler School of Art in Philadelphia and a BFA in Printmaking from SUNY New Paltz.

feeds.title: The Basketmaker's Wife
feeds.description: A blog about Lynne's art, her husband's basketry craft and the silly antics of their two dogs sprinkled in between.

feeds.title: The Norfolk Basket Company Blog
feeds.description: The Norfolk Basket Company create handmade willow baskets and provide basketry and willow weaving courses in Dordogne, France.

feeds.title: J Choate Basketry - News
feeds.description: J Choate Basketry have been crafting fine baskets for over twenty years. Jill breaks down elements on basket making by video demonstrating the techniques necessary to successfully weave up a variety of baskets.

feeds.title: Weaving by the Sea
feeds.description: Weaving by the Sea is a Mediterranean Basketry Holiday.

feeds.title: PrairieWood Basketry
feeds.description: Annetta Kraayeveld, artist owner of PrairieWood Basketry, is a basket weaver, designer and teaching artist.

feeds.title: Mitanjali Craft
feeds.description: Mitanjali Craft is a blog about craft and making paper baskets.

feeds.title: JASkets
feeds.description: Welcome to my new blog. I have no idea what I am going to do with this, but I am going to give it a try. Hopefully this will be a place for me to share my ideas, thoughts and rants on all things basketry (and I am sure a few other topics here and there). I am also going to post responses to some of the hundreds of questions I have received over the years.

feeds.title: Weaving magic naturally
feeds.description: Natural fibre basketry is a natural extension to growing your own foods. There are many techniques and methods to discover as well as many materials growing in your own garden.

feeds.title: Basketcase Miniatures
feeds.description: My name is Lidi and I live on the beautiful mid-north coast of New South Wales, Australia. I love all things miniature - my favourite scale is 1:12th - just because I love the detail and my favourite period is 'any time' as long as it is characterful and grungy.
